metadata.title: Manukyan et al. (2017) Nature — Ocellated Lizard (Timon lepidus) Skin-Scale Mesoscopic Cellular Automaton & Scale-Border Reaction-Diffusion Reference Dataset

sources.citation: Manukyan L, Montandon SA, Fofonjka A, Smirnov S, Milinkovitch MC (2017). A living mesoscopic cellular automaton made of skin scales. Nature 544(7649):173-179.
Kondo S, Asai R (1995). A reaction-diffusion wave on the skin of the marine angelfish Pomacanthus. Nature 376(6543):765-768.
Fofonjka A, Milinkovitch MC (2021). Reaction-diffusion in a growing 3D domain of skin scales generates a discrete cellular automaton. Nature Communications 12:2433.
Zakany S, Milinkovitch MC (2023). Simple Reaction-Diffusion Modeling Predicts Inconspicuous Neighborhood-Dependent Color Subclustering of Lizard Scales. Physical Review X 13(4):041011.

timon_lepidus_dorsal.species: Timon lepidus (Adult ocellated / jeweled lizard showing bimodal green and black hexagonal dorsal skin scales arranged in labyrinthine chains)
timon_lepidus_dorsal.author: Danelu (Wikimedia Commons)

scale_border_reaction_diffusion_model.section: Manukyan et al. (2017) Nature 544:173-179, Figs. 2-4 & Methods Eqs. (1)-(8)

governing_pde.u_eq: du/dt = F(u, v) - gamma_u * u + div(D_u(x) * grad(u)),  F(u, v) = clip(c_u * u + c_v * v + c_0, 0, F_max)
governing_pde.v_eq: dv/dt = G(u, v) - gamma_v * v + div(D_v(x) * grad(v)),  G(u, v) = clip(d_u * u + d_v * v + d_0, 0, G_max)
governing_pde.scale_border_diffusivity: D_s(x) = D_s,interior inside hexagonal scale cores |x - x_i| < R_scale; D_s(x) = P * D_s,interior on inter-scale borders
governing_pde.boundary_condition: Periodic or zero-flux Neumann boundary conditions on hexagonal scale lattice

hexagonal_outer_totalistic_ca.section: Manukyan et al. (2017) Nature 544:173-179, Figs. 3-4 (Mesoscopic Cellular Automaton Reduction)
hexagonal_outer_totalistic_ca.lattice_geometry: 2D 6-regular hexagonal grid of N_rows x N_cols skin scales with 6 first-nearest neighbors per interior scale

transition_probabilities_juvenile_to_adu.description: Empirical & theoretical outer-totalistic state-flip probabilities p(S_i -> 1 - S_i | n_green) per developmental step as a function of green neighbor count n_green in {0..6}

border_reduction_P_regimes.description: Zero inter-scale diffusivity (P=0): scales cannot exchange morphogens across borders; no labyrinthine correlation forms
Strong border constriction (P=0.08): ultra-high intra-scale uniformity and discrete scale-by-scale switching
Physiological Timon lepidus border thickness ratio (P=0.17): monochromatic scales with neighbor histogram peaking at n_green=3
Moderate border constriction (P=0.45): scales remain mostly uniform but occasional intra-scale gradients appear
Unattenuated continuum PDE (P=1.0, no scale border thinning): smooth reaction-diffusion bands cut across scale boundaries, reducing intra-scale color bimodality
